name: ePub Generator
description: Generates ePub 3 ebooks from Drupal content in pure PHP (no external binaries).

suggests.league/commonmark: Required for the Markdown file upload submodule (epub_generator_markdown).

project_description: Turn your Drupal content into real ebooks -- no external binaries, no headless browsers, no special hosting. ePub Generator produces valid ePub 3 files (with an ePub 2 NCX fallback and schema.org accessibility metadata) from any content entity or from whole Book outlines, using the pure-PHP andileco/php-epub library. It runs anywhere Drupal runs, needing only the zip and dom PHP extensions. A "Download ePub" tab appears on nodes, a generic download route serves other content entities, and Drush commands automate generation. Optional submodules add Book-outline assembly with configurable metadata field mapping, Markdown-file conversion, and an in-browser epub.js reader with response caching.
